FactionColonies.FCPolicyDef.label: Specialist Corps
FactionColonies.FCPolicyDef.desc: A formal specialist program that invests in training and capacity. Settlements can host more specialists, they learn faster, and their contributions are more impactful.

positiveEffects.li: - Specialists gain XP twice as fast

FactionColonies.FCPolicyDef.label: Meritocratic
FactionColonies.FCPolicyDef.desc: A society that rewards competence. Skilled governors are far more effective, but their higher status demands greater compensation.

positiveEffects.li: - Governor Social skill scaling widened (x0.75-2.0 instead of x0.5-1.5)
- Governor focus bonus increased to x2.0 (from x1.5)

negativeEffects.li: - Governor upkeep increased to x3 (from x2)

FactionColonies.FCPolicyDef.label: Professional Army
FactionColonies.FCPolicyDef.desc: Defense specialists are trained career soldiers. Their military contributions are doubled and they provide greater protection to civilians.

positiveEffects.li: - Death reduction per defender doubled (4% instead of 2%)

FactionColonies.FCPolicyDef.label: Patrician
FactionColonies.FCPolicyDef.desc: Governors are trained to manage diverse economic portfolios. They can focus on two resources simultaneously at full effectiveness.

positiveEffects.li: - Governors can set 2 focus resources (both at full x1.5 bonus)

FactionColonies.FCPolicyDef.label: Garrison Doctrine
FactionColonies.FCPolicyDef.desc: A standing garrison doctrine that keeps defense specialists safe and boosts settlement morale through visible security.

positiveEffects.li: - Defense specialist death chance halved (5% instead of 10%)
